physical.title: album; painting
physical.summary:
Portrait of the Hamlaci Basi; painting mounted onto an album  folio, B  side. The chief of the Sultan's oarsmen wears an orange hat (barata) on top of his head, a muslin robe, blue knee-breeches, orange stockings, brown shoes and a blue girdle.  He has a moustache and an unshaven stubbly chin.  Cut-outs of red tulips to either side. Inscribed.   Album    contains sixty folios   with fifty-nine  paintings    of  figures, and   additional    découpages, including   floral and vegetal    decoration  in  some   margins.

													         Ink and opaque  watercolour, with  découpage on paper. Album covered with      green leather.
